records.title: UI Payment Bug Triage & Resolution Meeting

transcript.speaker: Priya Sharma
transcript.text: Alright everyone, let's get started. We have 4 critical payment UI bugs to triage today. I've invited Deepak from Quantum Energy as a reference client, and Kiran from engineering. Let's go through each one.

transcript.speaker: Kiran Raj (Eng)
transcript.text: Thanks Priya. Bug 1 — the payment confirmation modal is dismissing before the server acknowledgment is received. We're seeing a race condition on slow 4G connections. Affects about 12% of mobile transactions over 4G.

transcript.speaker: Deepak Nair (Quantum)
transcript.text: This is exactly what we experienced. The transaction appeared successful in the app but was declined on the backend. Our vendor had to call us asking where the payment was.

transcript.speaker: Priya Sharma
transcript.text: Kiran, what's the fix timeline for Bug 1?

transcript.speaker: Kiran Raj (Eng)
transcript.text: We've already pushed a fix to staging. It awaits QA sign-off. Production deployment expected by today EOD.

transcript.speaker: Priya Sharma
transcript.text: Good. Bug 2 — the payment amount field is accepting amounts above the card limit without showing a real-time validation error, only failing at submission. That's a UX gap.

transcript.speaker: Kiran Raj (Eng)
transcript.text: Correct. We need to add client-side limit validation that mirrors the server validation. Estimated 2 days of frontend work.

transcript.speaker: Deepak Nair (Quantum)
transcript.text: Our users were confused — they filled out the entire form, hit submit, and got a cryptic error. They restarted the payment 3 times thinking it was a connection issue.

transcript.speaker: Priya Sharma
transcript.text: The UX error messaging needs a complete rewrite alongside the validation fix. Kiran, can we ensure the error message is plain English, no error codes?

transcript.speaker: Kiran Raj (Eng)
transcript.text: Agreed. We'll update the error copy as part of the same PR.

transcript.speaker: Priya Sharma
transcript.text: Bug 3 — the bulk payment CSV upload is silently dropping rows when the file has Windows-style CRLF line endings instead of Unix LF. This is a file parsing issue.

transcript.speaker: Kiran Raj (Eng)
transcript.text: Yes. Our CSV parser wasn't normalizing line endings. Fix is a 1-line code change — already in main branch. Will be in the next release.

transcript.speaker: Priya Sharma
transcript.text: Good. Bug 4 — the payment confirmation email is including the full card PAN in plaintext. This is a PCI-DSS violation and is the most critical issue today.

transcript.speaker: Kiran Raj (Eng)
transcript.text: Confirmed. This was introduced in the v2.8.3 release last week when we updated the email template. The fix — masking to last 4 digits — is ready. We need immediate hotfix deployment. I'm recommending we do it within the next 2 hours.

transcript.speaker: Deepak Nair (Quantum)
transcript.text: We received several of those emails. Our IT team flagged it as a security concern yesterday. I'm glad you're treating it as P0.

transcript.speaker: Priya Sharma
transcript.text: Kiran, please initiate the hotfix deployment immediately after this call. We also need to send a security advisory email to all affected clients — anyone who received a payment confirmation email since v2.8.3 was deployed.

transcript.speaker: Kiran Raj (Eng)
transcript.text: Understood. I'll coordinate with InfoSec for the advisory draft. We should also notify RBI as required under the Digital Payments framework.

transcript.speaker: Priya Sharma
transcript.text: Yes — loop in our Compliance team for the RBI notification. Alright, let's close — Bug 4 is P0/immediate, Bug 1 is EOD, Bugs 2 and 3 are within 48 hours. Any questions?

transcript.speaker: Deepak Nair (Quantum)
transcript.text: Will we get written confirmation of the timeline and the security advisory?

transcript.speaker: Priya Sharma
transcript.text: Yes Deepak, I'll send a written summary to all affected clients within 1 hour of this meeting ending. Thank you all.

ai_summary.executive: Critical triage meeting resolved 4 UI payment bugs. Bug 4 (PAN exposed in plaintext emails — PCI-DSS violation, introduced in v2.8.3) classified P0 and requires immediate hotfix and client security advisory. Bugs 1, 2, 3 have 2–48 hour resolution windows.
ai_summary.evidence: Kiran Raj (Turn 13): 'This was introduced in the v2.8.3 release... The fix — masking to last 4 digits — is ready. I'm recommending we do it within the next 2 hours.' Deepak Nair (Turn 14): 'Our IT team flagged it as a security concern yesterday.'
ai_summary.negative_scope: Hotfix not yet deployed at time of meeting end — deployment was to begin immediately after. RBI notification not yet filed — Compliance team to be looped in. Number of affected clients receiving PAN-exposed emails is not quantified in this transcript.
ai_summary.action_items: 1. Kiran Raj: Deploy PAN masking hotfix within 2 hours (P0). 2. InfoSec + Compliance: Draft and send security advisory to all clients who received confirmation emails since v2.8.3. 3. Compliance: File RBI notification per Digital Payments framework. 4. Priya Sharma: Send written bug timeline summary to affected clients within 1 hour. 5. Engineering: Deploy Bug 1 fix by EOD, Bugs 2 & 3 within 48 hours.
